title: Economics and Management of Community Development

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts about communities and community development.
Identify and understand objectives and motivations for community development.
Manage resources effectively for community development projects.
Understand and apply institutional frameworks for community development.
Develop and manage community development projects.
Apply organizational methods for managing community development.
Enhance self-learning abilities and research skills.
Improve presentation skills and ability to deliver conclusions on economic and management issues in community development.
Work effectively in teams and contribute to group projects.
Analyze problems critically and provide solutions for community development issues.
